err_string_repeat_count.message: String repetition requires a non-negative safe integer count.

err_string_repeat_size.message: The repeated string is too large.

err_list_index_integer.message: An index must be a single integer.

err_list_index_target.message: Indexed values must be iterable (list, string, fragment or range).

guide_doc_list_index_desc.message: Use [index] on lists, strings, fragments and ranges. Indices start at zero; -1 reads the last item. Strings count Unicode characters. Fragments count characters and cursors, returning a one-item fragment. Ranges return numbers in iteration order. Indices must be integers; out-of-range indices return undefined. Nested indexing and function results are supported.

err_join_list_required.message: The first argument to join() must be a list.

guide_doc_split_desc.message: Split a string or fragment into a list with a literal separator. Empty fields are preserved. An empty separator splits a fragment into Unicode characters and cursor nodes, each wrapped in a fragment. A fragment separator can match cursor nodes.

guide_doc_join_desc.message: Combine list elements with a separator. If an element or the separator is a fragment, return a fragment and preserve its cursors; otherwise return a string. null and undefined elements become empty text.

tester_description.message: Type a trigger below to test expansion. Current edits apply immediately, including unsaved changes. Site restrictions are ignored in the tester. Cursor navigation and undo shortcuts work here too.

tester_rich_description.message: Test snippet expansion and cursor navigation in an editable web page area, which has a different structure from a regular input field.

subgroups_remove_desc.message: Remove this subgroup and move its snippets to Ungrouped. No snippets are deleted.

subgroups_empty.message: Drag snippets here or choose this subgroup from their move menu.

err_toast_color.message: Invalid toast color. Use a CSS color such as #22c55e, red, or rgb(...).

err_function_arguments.message: The argument count or syntax for function $1 is invalid.

err_unclosed_string.message: A string is missing its closing quote.

err_template_unclosed_tag.message: A template tag is missing its closing }}.

err_cursor_level.message: Cursor levels must be non-negative safe integers.

err_snippet_cursor_offset.message: The cursor offset must be a non-negative safe integer, and shifted cursor levels must remain safe integers.

err_range_integer_bounds.message: Range endpoints and the range length must be safe integers.

err_snippet_call_target.message: Snippet "$1" must have a unique name in the same group.

err_snippet_call_args.message: Snippet "$1" requires $2 arguments in trigger capture order.

groups_no_group.message: Select a group or create one to start.

groups_delete_confirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete this group?

settings_next_cursor_desc.message: Set the hotkey to jump to the next placeholder after replacement.

settings_undo_expansion_desc.message: Press Ctrl+Z after a snippet expands to restore its trigger text.

settings_add_snippet_desc.message: Set the hotkey to quickly add a new snippet in the editor.

settings_toggle_fold_desc.message: Collapse or expand the details of the currently selected snippet.

settings_particles_desc.message: Show particles and wave effects when a snippet is replaced.

settings_shift_cursor_desc.message: Automatically shifts existing placeholders backward to prioritize the newly inserted snippet's flow.

settings_visualize_newlines_desc.message: Display a visual marker (↵) at the end of each line in the snippet editor.

settings_reset_confirm.message: This will wipe all your snippets and settings. Are you sure?

default_snippet_replacement.message:
Hello, {{cursor}}!
I'm here to guide you about {{cursor}} today.

app_description.message: Intelligent text expansion tool with powerful syntax and dynamic features.

err_elif_else_outside_if.message: elif/else can only be used inside an if block.

err_if_unclosed.message: if block is not closed (missing endif).

err_for_unclosed.message: for loop is not closed (missing endfor).

err_switch_unclosed.message: switch block is not closed (missing endswitch).

err_case_unclosed.message: case block is not closed (missing endcase).

err_default_unclosed.message: default block is not closed (missing enddefault).

err_assignment_instead_of_comparison.message: Use '==' instead of '=' for comparison in conditions.

err_logical_operator_single.message: Use '&&', '||' instead of '&', '|' for logical operators.

err_unmatched_close_paren.message: Closing parenthesis ')' has no matching opening parenthesis.

err_unmatched_open_paren.message: Opening parenthesis '(' has no matching closing parenthesis.

err_index_outside_for.message: index can only be used inside a for loop.

err_set_operator_required.message: set syntax requires '=' or compound assignment (+=, -=, etc.).

status_sync_conflict_confirm.message: Synced settings changed on another device while you were editing. Press OK to use the remote settings, or Cancel to keep this device's settings.

guide_doc_plain_desc.message: Plain text is inserted as written. A tag inserts the result of its expression.

guide_doc_strings_desc.message: Wrap strings in double or single quotes. Separate function arguments with commas. Close every quote; escape a matching quote inside a string with a backslash (\).

guide_doc_start_intro.message: A trigger is the shortcut you type. The body is the text inserted in its place. Inside the body, {{…}} evaluates a variable, expression or function.

guide_doc_capture_value_desc.message: Write a variable name and regular expression in the trigger, then read it as $name in the body. Flags are optional. For example, \d+ captures one or more digits.

guide_doc_capture_intro.message: Capture part of the typed text and reuse it in the body.

guide_doc_set_value_desc.message: set stores a value without inserting text. Update an existing value with +=, -=, *=, /= or %=. Separate multiple assignments or declarations with commas, for example {{set $a = 3, $b = 5}}. They run from left to right, so later expressions can use earlier updates. Commas inside strings, functions or lists do not separate assignments.

guide_doc_operators_desc.message: Use parentheses to control evaluation order. Compare with == and combine conditions with && (and) or || (or). A conditional expression uses condition ? value_if_true : value_if_false. Multiply a string by a non-negative integer to repeat it: "ab" * 3 or 3 * "ab" produces "ababab". Zero produces an empty string; *= also supports repetition.

guide_doc_range_value_desc.message: A range includes both integer endpoints. 2~5 means 2, 3, 4, 5; 5~2 runs in reverse. Endpoints can be variables or expressions. Store a range in a variable or pass it to random(), for or a snippet function.

guide_doc_scope.message: Variable scope: you can update an outer variable inside a block. A variable first created inside an if, for or switch block disappears when that block ends.

guide_doc_values_intro.message: Use captured values or values you store yourself in expressions.

guide_doc_cursor_note.message: After expansion, type after Name, then use the next-position shortcut to move after Email.

guide_doc_cursor_positions_desc.message: Visit the lowest number first; equal numbers share a step. {{cursor}} and {{#cursor}} are aliases for zero. Only tags written in the snippet source create cursors. Cursor syntax inside strings, captures, prompts or pasted text remains literal.

guide_doc_cursor_dynamic_desc.message: Use a variable or expression that evaluates to a nonnegative integer.

guide_doc_cursors_intro.message: Choose where to continue typing after expansion and the order of cursor stops. Next and previous navigation use the shortcuts in General Settings.

guide_doc_if_note.message: /task bug inserts [BUG], /task feature inserts [FEATURE], and other values insert [TASK]. A backslash (\) at each line end removes the line break so the result stays on one line. Without it, line breaks in the selected body are also inserted.

guide_doc_if_branch_desc.message: Use the first true branch, starting with if. Add elif and else only when needed.

guide_doc_switch_note.message: A or B inserts Pass; any other value inserts Review. Line breaks outside case and default bodies are ignored, so no backslash (\) is needed after switch, endcase or enddefault. The backslashes shown remove only line breaks within the selected body.

guide_doc_switch_branch_desc.message: Compare one value with several candidates. A case can list multiple comma-separated values. If none match, use the optional default block; close it with enddefault.

guide_doc_conditions_intro.message: Insert only the matching branch. Pair every opening block tag with its closing tag.

guide_doc_loop_count_desc.message: A number repeats the body that many times. index starts at zero. Convert captured numeric strings with num() or int() to repeat by count.

guide_doc_loop_range_desc.message: For ranges, index is the zero-based position and value is the current number. value moves from start to end in steps of one, in either direction, including both endpoints. A variable holding a range also works.

guide_doc_loops_intro.message: Repeat by a numeric count, or iterate over a list, string, fragment or range.

guide_doc_text_transform_desc.message: upper and lower change text case; capitalize uppercases the first text character. trim removes leading and trailing whitespace. With a fragment, these functions return a fragment and preserve cursors. A cursor stops whitespace trimming at that edge.

guide_doc_text_extract_desc.message: len returns the length. substr returns the requested length starting at the given position. For fragments, each Unicode character or cursor counts as one item. substr and replace return fragments and preserve remaining cursors; replace matches the first occurrence, with fragment replacements inserted literally.

guide_doc_text_match_desc.message: Return whether the value starts or ends with the given text or fragment. Fragment matching distinguishes a cursor node from literal cursor syntax in a string.

guide_doc_text_intro.message: Transform, slice, split and join strings and fragments. Positions start at zero; each cursor in a fragment counts as one item.

guide_doc_cast_value_desc.message: str converts a value to a string. For fragments it writes cursor nodes as {{#number}} syntax; this becomes ordinary text and is never interpreted as cursors again. num converts to a number, and int truncates the fractional part.

guide_doc_math_value_desc.message: round rounds to the nearest integer, ceil rounds up, and floor rounds down. min and max select the smallest or largest argument.

guide_doc_random_note.message: The first line is an integer from 1 to 6. The second is red, blue or green.

guide_doc_random_value_title.message: Choose randomly from a range or list

guide_doc_random_value_desc.message: A range returns a random integer including both endpoints. Multiple arguments return one randomly chosen argument.

guide_doc_uuid_value_desc.message: Generate a random UUID v4 identifier.

guide_doc_numbers_intro.message: Inspect value types, convert values and perform calculations. Convert captured numeric strings before doing arithmetic.

guide_doc_date_note.message: Displays the date and time when the snippet runs.

guide_doc_date_value_desc.message: Omit the format to use the default. YYYY, MM and DD are date tokens; HH, mm and ss are time tokens; ddd and dddd are weekday tokens. Tokens are case-sensitive.

guide_doc_page_value_desc.message: Read the current page URL, domain and title.

guide_doc_system_intro.message: Read the current time or information from the page where expansion runs.

guide_doc_prompt_value_desc.message: Open an input dialog and return the entered value. Cancelling stops expansion and restores the original trigger.

guide_doc_choice_value_desc.message: Open a menu and return the selected option. Number keys 1–9 also select options.

guide_doc_toast_note.message: Shows a Done toast with a green accent.

guide_doc_toast_value_desc.message: Display a message for six seconds using a CSS color. Inserts no text. Colors can be #22c55e, red or rgb(...). A new toast replaces the previous one.

guide_doc_interaction_intro.message: Collect input or display a toast during expansion.

guide_doc_snippet_call_title.message: Call by name and pass arguments

guide_doc_snippet_call_desc.message: Write the snippet name after @. Captures in its trigger become parameters from left to right; the argument count must match. Missing or duplicate names cause an error. Double-click the function name in the body editor to jump to that snippet.

guide_doc_quote_alternative.message: Using single quotes for the name, @'hello world'("Guest"), works the same way.

guide_doc_snippet_quoted_desc.message: Wrap names containing spaces or special characters in double or single quotes. The quoted name must exactly match the saved snippet name.

guide_doc_shift_alternative.message: @func<2>() produces the same result. Use @func()<$offset + 1> to compute the offset from a variable.

guide_doc_snippet_shift_title.message: Shift cursor numbers in the result

guide_doc_snippet_shift_desc.message: Put an optional <offset> before or after (). It must be a nonnegative integer and defaults to zero. Variables and expressions also work. {{cursor}} and {{#cursor}} count as stop zero; nested offsets add up.

guide_doc_call_scope.message: Called snippets use a separate variable scope with their supplied arguments; caller variables are not shared automatically. Recursive calls are supported. Adjust maximum function nesting depth and execution time in Advanced settings.

guide_doc_calls_title.message: Call another snippet as a function

guide_doc_calls_intro.message: Reuse the body of another snippet in the same group, including snippets in other subgroups.

guide_doc_line_join_title.message: Write across lines, insert on one line

guide_doc_line_join_desc.message: A backslash (\) at the end of a line removes the line break and indentation on the next line. Use it to lay out a template without inserting those breaks.

guide_doc_backspace_value_desc.message: Perform one backspace to delete the previous character.

guide_doc_formatting_intro.message: Whitespace and line breaks in the body are preserved by default.

guide_doc_intro.message: Read from the top to learn the basics, or jump to a topic using the contents. Expand an example whenever you need it.

guide_doc_range_note.message: $range stores the range 2~5. Use it in loops and random selection, described below.

guide_doc_paste_value_desc.message: Read and insert text from the clipboard.

guide_doc_copy_value_desc.message: Convert a value to text and copy it to the clipboard without inserting text into the body. Variables, expressions and snippet function results are supported.

guide_doc_copy_note.message: Copies Hello, Guest! to the clipboard. You can also copy a computed value, such as {{copy(upper('hello'))}}.

err_clipboard_copy_failed.message: Could not copy to the clipboard.

settings_add_subgroup_desc.message: Set the hotkey to add a subgroup to the current group in the snippet editor tab.

guide_doc_type_value_desc.message: Return the value type as a string: string, fragment, number, bool, range, list, null or undefined. Snippet calls return fragments. Captured variables remain strings; num() and int() convert them to numbers. An undefined variable name causes an error.

guide_doc_declare_value_title.message: Declare a variable without a value

guide_doc_declare_value_desc.message: Omitting the value stores undefined. Assign a value later; until then, inserting the variable produces empty text. Using this form on an existing variable resets its value to undefined.

groups_delete_message.message: Delete "{name}" and all snippets in it?

settings_reload_snippets.message: Reload snippets on the current page

settings_reload_snippets_desc.message: Reload the latest saved settings when an open page still expands older snippets.

status_snippets_reload_failed.message: Could not reload snippets. Refresh the page and try again.

settings_execution_timeout_desc.message: Defaults to 0.5 seconds; adjustable from 0.1 to 60 seconds. Expansion stops when the limit is exceeded. Time spent waiting for prompt or choice input is excluded.

err_snippet_timeout.message: The snippet exceeded its execution time limit ($1 seconds).

settings_execution_timeout_drag.message: Drag to adjust · Type a value

err_list_syntax.message: Invalid list syntax. Close the square brackets and separate elements with commas.

guide_doc_list_value_desc.message: Separate elements with commas inside square brackets. Lists can contain numbers, strings, variables, expressions and other lists; [] is empty. type() returns list and len() returns the element count. Direct output uses [1,2,3] notation with double quotes around string elements.

settings_call_depth_desc.message: Recursive calls are allowed. The default depth is 32 (range: 1–256). Expansion stops when this limit is exceeded. The currently expanding snippet counts toward the depth.

err_loop_control_outside_for.message: $1 can only be used inside a for loop.

err_list_concat_types.message: Both operands must be lists when concatenating lists with +.

guide_doc_list_concat_desc.message: Use + to combine two lists into a new list in order. Original lists stay unchanged and nested lists stay nested. += is also supported. Both operands must be lists; wrap a single item in [value] to append it.

guide_doc_loop_control_desc.message: break ends the nearest for loop. continue skips the rest of the current iteration. Output produced before the tag is preserved. Both work inside if and switch blocks. A called snippet cannot control its caller’s loop.

err_list_function_target.message: The first argument to $1 must be a list.

err_list_subtract_types.message: Both operands must be lists when removing list values with -.

guide_doc_list_remove_desc.message: list - list returns a new list with all items matching values on the right removed. -= is supported. Remaining items keep their order, and different types remain distinct. Nested lists and ranges match by contents. Both operands must be lists.

guide_doc_list_insert_at_desc.message: Insert a value before index in a list, string or fragment. A list receives one item. A fragment receives text or fragment content while preserving cursors; inserting a fragment into a string also returns a fragment. len(target) appends and -1 inserts before the last item. Indices must be integers; out-of-range indices leave contents unchanged. Strings count Unicode characters; fragments also count each cursor as one item. Readonly ranges are not supported.

guide_doc_list_remove_at_desc.message: Return a new list, string or fragment with the item at index removed. 0 is the first item and -1 the last. A fragment cursor is one complete removable item. Out-of-range integer indices leave contents unchanged. Readonly ranges are not supported. Assign the returned value to update a variable.

snippets_enabled_hint.message: Enable trigger expansion · Can still be called as a snippet function when disabled.

err_iterable_function_target.message: The first argument to $1 must be a list, string or fragment.

err_readonly_iterable.message: range is a readonly iterable and cannot be used with $1.

err_value_outside_for.message: value can only be used inside a for loop.

guide_doc_iterable_desc.message: Lists, strings and fragments are iterable. for visits their items, and insertAt/removeAt return edited values. A range is readonly. Strings use Unicode code points; fragments count each Unicode character or cursor as one item. type() returns list, string, fragment or range.

guide_doc_loop_iterable_desc.message: For every iterable loop, index is the zero-based position and value is the current item. A fragment yields a one-item fragment for each Unicode character or cursor, so printing value preserves its cursor. Enclosing index/value are restored after nested loops. value is separate from $value. Numeric count loops make value equal to index. Use num() or int() to turn numeric text into a repetition count.

export_dialog_description.message: Compressed binary reduces file size. JSON lets you read or edit the contents as text. Both formats can be imported.

guide_doc_fragment_desc.message: A snippet call returns a fragment containing text and cursor nodes. Variables and parameters preserve it. Concatenating with + or repeating with * preserves cursors. String operations support fragments, and len, indexing and for count each Unicode character or cursor as one item. str explicitly converts the fragment to ordinary text including its cursor syntax.

guide_doc_is_cursor_title.message: Check whether a value is a cursor

guide_doc_is_cursor_desc.message: isCursor(value) returns true only for a fragment containing exactly one cursor node. It returns false for text, literal cursor syntax, empty fragments, mixed content or multiple cursors. Use it with value in a fragment loop or with an indexed item.

err_includes_iterable_target.message: The first argument to includes must be iterable (list, string, fragment or range).

guide_doc_includes_title.message: Check whether a value is included

guide_doc_includes_desc.message: includes(iterable, value) searches for a substring or fragment within text. Fragment matches preserve cursor identity: a cursor node differs from literal cursor syntax. For lists, compare complete elements by value, including nested lists, ranges and fragments, without type conversion. For ranges, check whether an integer is between the endpoints in either direction. Empty text matches any text. Other search values are converted to text when searching text.

guide_doc_has_cursor_title.message: Check whether a fragment contains cursors

guide_doc_has_cursor_desc.message: hasCursor(fragment) returns true when a fragment contains at least one actual cursor node, even among text or other cursors. Empty fragments, plain text and non-fragment values return false. Literal cursor syntax and str(fragment) are ordinary text. isCursor(value) instead requires exactly one cursor node.

err_unclosed_fragment_literal.message: Close the fragment literal with a backtick (`).

guide_doc_fragment_literal_desc.message: Wrap a snippet body in backticks (`) to create a fragment. Cursor tags, expressions, variables, branches, loops and snippet calls use the same {{...}} syntax as a snippet body. Evaluation reads the current variables; assignments inside the literal remain local. Use \` for a literal backtick and \\ for a backslash in its text. Newlines are preserved. Quoted strings remain ordinary text, and str(fragment) serializes cursor syntax as text.

guide_doc_fragment_cast_desc.message: fragment(value) interprets a string using the same body syntax as a backtick literal, including cursor tags, expressions, variables and control flow. Existing fragments are returned unchanged. Evaluation reads current variables while keeping assignments local. Other values first convert to text, with null and undefined becoming empty text.

guide_doc_bool_cast_desc.message: bool(value) uses the same truth test as if. false, zero, NaN, null, undefined, empty text, and the exact strings "false" and "0" become false. Fragments are tested using their text representation, so an empty fragment is false and a cursor-only fragment is true. Other values, including empty lists and ranges, become true. type() returns "bool" for the result.
